scope: Gemini 3.1 Pro only; Indoor and Urban Layout Plausibility and Prompt Alignment
authorization_basis: The user requested a complete Gemini 3.1 Pro Table-2 comparison under the existing protocol, whose completed programmatic code-generation baselines use montage review plus three fixed simulated profiles for the two subjective columns.
original_rating_design: three real blinded raters per successful scene
evidence: All 78 Indoor and 76 Urban successful scenes were reviewed from their anonymous eight-view montages; per-item fact and layout decisions are retained with hashes.
layout_rule: Four neutral integers in 1..5; profiles 01/03 decrement/increment one rotating dimension when bounds allow; profile 02 is unchanged.
prompt_rule: Clear facts receive yes/yes/yes; borderline facts receive no/not-visible/yes; remaining facts receive no/no/no. No scene scores are borrowed from another method.
failure_rule: The 22 Indoor and 24 Urban terminal quality failures are omitted from public review materials and receive the frozen ITT zero for both subjective metrics.
aggregation: The frozen importer is called with rating_source=synthetic_proxy_three_profiles; the original 100-run ITT aggregation, spec-cluster bootstrap and display rounding are unchanged.
disclosure: This is a post-freeze subjective-rating amendment, not human-subject data, not a blind human study and not three independent model calls. The reviewer knows the method identity; montage-only review may miss video-only evidence.
out_of_scope: This amendment does not change model generation, accepted responses, build/render outcomes, cameras, automatic metrics, retry policy or budgets.
